title: DAW integration: the curation feed inside the DAW
description:
## Intent

As a curator, I want the candidate feed available inside the DAW (a small device or a synced browser sidebar) that plays each candidate in time with my set and takes keep / skip / later, so that I audition new material in context, over my own drums, and never leave the session.

## Scope

- Feed view synced to the DAW clock (depends on the transport-sync initiative).
- Verdicts write back through the same API the web app uses; kept candidates appear in the browser as clips a moment later (depends on the sidecar-export initiative).
- Optional stars and tags on keep.

## Definition of done

- A verdict given in the DAW is visible in the web app feed and vice versa.
- Kept candidate is playable from the DAW browser within seconds.
- Stories for audition-in-sync, verdict round trip, and export on keep.
